scope: Exactly five same-item drafts; original section01 and amended section02. No sixth researched item.
decision_semantics: approved-as-draft / reviewed-as-draft approves corrective finding or bounded evidence draft only, not live mutation, inventory completeness, quantitative suitability, availability, route implementation, physical acceptance, terminal or closure.

operations.rationale: Module-specific mechanical/electrical/firmware compatibility, USB signaling and operator-interface requirements are supported; target values and allocation remain open.
operations.required_owner_work: Coordinator with domain owners: freeze measurable target; allocate cleaning/support/storage, test contacts, rejected/waste stock, battery protection placement and loading/X-ray overlap. Preserve all34 current immediate obligations through actual consumers.

operations.rationale: Commercial tablet RF splits and milling support/chip control are narrow precedents. They do not qualify generic cast aluminum, chosen alloy/temper, manual precision or a mandatory insert.
operations.required_owner_work: Mechanical/radio: freeze drawing/material; allocate cutters/wear/chip collection/cleaning and lubricant or supported dry-cut method. Validate RF interfaces only for chosen geometry; compare alternate inventories separately.

operations.rationale: Amendment adds genuine small-batch cabinet and unreinforced Makrolon/Apec TVI alternatives while retaining quantitative moisture and grade-specific qualification gaps. TVI is screening, not a numerical low-water assay.
operations.required_owner_work: Mechanical/chemistry/facilities/metrology: select grade and conditioning/transfer path, qualify mold fill/clamp/vents/demolding/thermal capacity, allocate consumables and quantitative assay only where required. Current dew-point frontier is not pellet-water qualification.

operations.rationale: Direct record/caller comparison: fiber-packing preparation does not establish unfrozen phone ingress, optical or aging requirements. This is unqualified suitability, not universal physical impossibility.
operations.required_owner_work: Mechanical/facilities: define each seal's chemistry/contact/compression/environment/aging duty before adapting shared stock or requesting distinct state. Retain known seal reachability.

operations.rationale: Amendment correctly retains advertised profile features as manufacturer claims and actual-glass constants/range/uncertainty as unqualified; separates dynamic edge damage from subsequent four-point bending.
operations.identity_decision: Approve as draft distinct capability requests compared with inspected microscope/length/joint/barrier/wheel functions; no ID insertion or physical qualification. Owner may justify extension instead.
operations.required_owner_work: Mechanical/facilities: cutting/edge/rinse, recipe/salt-contact vessel, handling/fuel/coupon/waste stock. Electrical/metrology: coupling optics/media, wavelength/fringe range, glass optical constants and independent references/host/power; distinct impact/bend geometry and force/velocity reference duties. G2 commercial mechanism is an example; earlier alternatives need their own evidence.

operations.rationale: Repeated declared substrate/FPC rows and source-described deposition on a processed substrate justify a state/quantity ledger, not automatic deletion or three consumed sheets.
operations.required_owner_work: Facilities/display with electronics: distinguish bare/backplane/OLED/encapsulated intermediate, actual FPC/driver installation stage, extra trial stock and repeated containment/reuse. Preserve every true manufacturing requirement via actual consumer.

operations.rationale: Rigid lid/frit/laser and flexible TFE examples are distinct. Selected rigid/TFE compatibility/lifetime remains unproved but is not disproved by these sources.
operations.required_owner_work: Facilities/display: choose coherent stack and collect direct compatibility/thermal/chemical/lifetime evidence. Keep current selected TFE conditional/open and alternative lid/seal/preconditioning/laser/UV duties separate. Do not union recipes or remove unknown barrier obligations.

operations.rationale: Amendment preserves different RGB mask patterns, mask-set/count, installed carrier/alignment and conditional reticle-patterning reuse. Candidate mask apparatus is not selected available FMM capability; microscope is not photometric/barrier qualification.
amendments_confirmed: Explicit unselected mask-making candidate construction route
